assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished cinematic key art for the main menu of a portrait mobile space strategy game called Die letzte Werft. Create a vertical 1024x1536 illustration with absolutely no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. A solitary operational shipyard orbital station is humanity's safe home, suspended over the dark night side of a distant planet. Sophisticated hard-surface science fiction, practical ivory and dark navy modular hulls, restrained brass structural details, two unmistakable drydock arms framing a small carrier under repair, subtle cyan dock lighting and warm amber maintenance lights, a tiny sense of scale from two support craft. Hopeful resilience and quiet tension, not a battle scene, no laser beams, no starfield noise. Premium painted 3D concept-art finish with excellent legible silhouettes. Composition for a portrait game menu: the upper 30 percent is calm deep navy negative space for a title; the detailed shipyard is centered in the middle 45 percent, comfortably contained within the frame; the lower 25 percent fades gently into almost-black navy for menu buttons. Camera is an elegant oblique cinematic view, deliberately different from the top-down battlefield. Restrained navy/ivory/brass/cyan palette, believable materials, soft rim light from the planet, beautiful controlled contrast. No extra buildings, no fleet battle, no decorative HUD rings.
assets.use: Main menu key art; unedited original

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas for a mobile portrait space strategy game, two equal square frames arranged horizontally in a wide 2:1 transparent PNG. Primary request: exactly two states of the same enemy orbital SHIELD RELAY structure, active on the left and disabled on the right. Orthographic top-down camera looking straight down, absolutely no perspective or visible sides, centered identical scale and silhouette in both frames. Compact sophisticated hard-surface station with dark graphite panels, restrained copper metal, four short radial armored arms and a strong circular central shield generator. Active frame: clear bright violet and cyan central core, small violet power coils, controlled restrained illumination. Disabled frame: exact same hull and orientation, core dark and cracked, a few scorched panels, no power lights, recognizably disabled but hull remains as rubble. Each object occupies about 70 percent of its square frame, comfortably spaced, no fragments crossing frames. Premium clean 3D game sprite finish, crisp outer silhouette and readable details at 70px, materials and light consistent in both states. Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the objects; no space background, no floor, no drop shadow beyond hull, no starfield. Constraints: no text, labels, numbers, logos, UI, border, grid, reference lines, watermark, rings around the entire object, extra spacecraft or other objects. Both states must be visible from directly overhead and share the same center within their respective halves.
assets.use: Unedited transparent two-state atlas; runtime draws left active / right disabled
